Brains, personas, modelos de IA y ajuste: Brains, people, AI models and the instance's settings. What you see here depends on your role.
Cada brain es una memoria separada, con: Each brain is a separate memory, with its own people and permissions. Here you choose the one you work with: every screen shows the active brain.
El menú reparte la aplicación en tres pa: The menu splits the application in three: Memory, with what the brain knows; Explore, to ask and walk the graph; and Curation, to review what comes in.
Haz una pregunta con tus palabras y obté: Ask a question in your own words and get an answer with the brain's facts that back it.
La documentación, el código, dónde conta: The documentation, the source code, where to report a bug, and this tour, in case you want to see it again.
Las entidades y sus relaciones, dibujada: Entities and their relations, drawn. Select an entity to see its facts, or expand its neighbours to follow the thread.
Lo que tus agentes y tus compañeros quie: What your agents and your colleagues want to keep arrives as a proposal. Whoever curates the brain approves, corrects or rejects it before it enters the memory.
Un recorrido de un minuto por lo princip: A one-minute tour of the main parts of the interface. You can skip it and replay it whenever you like from the help menu.
